title: 1625 Prairie's back door steps down to a sunken entry
items: In 1904, the door at the foot of 1625 Prairie's tall rear wing is now a full-height door whose sill sits about 0.6 m below the sidewalk. The 1890 photograph shows too short a door above the sidewalk for it to sit at street level.
It opens on a small sunken entry with four steps down from the walk, hidden behind the fence in the photograph and drawn as our best reconstruction.
